effect.clanginghowl.cosmic_irradiation.d: Decreases max health by 15%% and attack damage by 10%%; higher levels decreases further.
effect.clanginghowl.sawing_up_health.des: Decreases max health by 5%%; higher levels decreases further.
effect.clanginghowl.weakened_defense.des: Decreases armor by 40%%; higher levels decreases further.
effect.clanginghowl.overdrive.descriptio: Increases melee damage by 4 and movement speed by 45%%.
effect.clanginghowl.internal_heat.descri: Emits non-destructive explosion that gives effect, and sets fire, to other entities.
effect.clanginghowl.neurotoxin.descripti: Inflicts damage over time, when moving; higher levels do more damage per second.
effect.clanginghowl.beyond_flesh.descrip: Certain affected will transform into a techno-flesh creature after effect nearly finishes.
effect.clanginghowl.enlightened.descript: Affected will glow green and receive 30%% more damage from physical damage.
effect.clanginghowl.attraction.descripti: Entities within 20 blocks will follow, or target if monster, the affected.
enchantment.clanginghowl.energy_efficien: Applies to all advanced tools. For each level, reduces energy consumption by one.
enchantment.clanginghowl.ecological_ener: Applies to all advanced tools. Passively charges when the holder is exposed to direct sunlight. When the holder is struck by lightning, charges 400 energy
Applies to Advanced Drills. Dig in a 3x3 area unless sneaking. Increases energy consumption.
enchantment.clanginghowl.overdrive.desc: Applies to Advanced Chainsaws. Grants Overdrive effect when using item, increasing movement speed and damage. Increases energy consumption.
enchantment.clanginghowl.full_power.desc: Applies to Advanced Chainsaws. Makes chainsaw to rapidly damage enemies in front when using it, slowly causing it to overheat. Increases energy consumption.
enchantment.clanginghowl.killer_charge.d: Applies to Advanced Chainswords. Cause an electrical surge after killing, damaging other entities and charges all advanced tools in inventory.
enchantment.clanginghowl.exceeding_the_l: Applies to Advanced Chainswords. Increase melee damage by 0.5 and increases max Sawing Up Health effect level stack to 10.
enchantment.clanginghowl.fuel_saving.des: Applies to Flamethrowers. For each level, reduces fuel consumption by one.
enchantment.clanginghowl.napalm_stream.d: Applies to Flamethrowers. For each level, increases flamethrower damage and fire duration. Increases fuel consumption.
enchantment.clanginghowl.chain_burn.desc: Applies to Flamethrowers. Gives entities Internal Heat that will cause them to emit a blast upon death that gives effect to other nearby entities.
enchantment.clanginghowl.fuel_burst.desc: Applies to Flamethrowers. Change the Flamethrower to only shoot a short burst that damages and pushes away entities. Increases fuel consumption.
enchantment.clanginghowl.soul_burner.des: Applies to Flamethrowers. Increases flame damage by one and inflicts slowness for a short time. Nearby entities dying by fire fuels held flamethrower a bit.
info.clanginghowl.energy.empty: The tool does not have enough energy
info.clanginghowl.tool.empty: This gadget does not have enough energy
info.clanginghowl.item.extraterrestrial: §8-Attacks inflict §5Cosmic Irradiation §8on the opponent and also deal increased damage to §4techno-flesh §8creatures.
info.clanginghowl.item.hammer: §8-Right-clicking on some industrial blocks will cause them to become damaged.
info.clanginghowl.item.wrench.0: §8-Right-clicking on some industrial blocks allows you to turn them §2on §8and §4off§8, as well as repair damaged versions of the blocks.
info.clanginghowl.item.wrench.1: §8-You can also right-click to repair damaged golems and robots.
info.clanginghowl.item.drill.0: §7Holding the right mouse button allows you to quickly mine stone and earth blocks.
info.clanginghowl.item.drill.1: §7Each second of use consumes energy. The tool can be charged using a Portable Charger or a Stationary Charging Station.
info.clanginghowl.item.chainsaw.0: §7Holding the right mouse button allows you to quickly mine wooden and plant blocks.
info.clanginghowl.item.chainsaw.1: §7Each second of use consumes energy. The tool can be charged using a Portable Charger or a Stationary Charging Station.
info.clanginghowl.item.chainsword.0: §7Critical hits reduce the opponent's maximum health by §45§4%§7, repeated critical hits increase the effect, up to a maximum of §425§4%.
info.clanginghowl.item.chainsword.2: §7Attacks consume energy. The tool can be charged using a Portable Charger or a Stationary Charging Station.
info.clanginghowl.item.flamethrower.0: §7Holding the right mouse button launches a stream of flame that burns everything in front of it. Enemies hit by the stream of flame take increased fire damage.
info.clanginghowl.item.flamethrower.1: §7Every second of use consumes fuel. The fuel cylinder can be replaced if you have a §eBlaze Fuel Cylinder §7in your inventory.
info.clanginghowl.item.charger.0: §7Passively transfers §eEnergy §7from the batteries in its storage to advanced tools in your inventory.
info.clanginghowl.item.x_ray.0: §7To turn the gadget on or off, press the §2%s §7button while crouching.
info.clanginghowl.item.x_ray.1: §7While the gadget is active, you gain night vision and §aEnlighten §7other mobs in your line of sight, making them visible through obstacles. Enlightened mobs also take 30% more physical damage, revealing their weak points.
info.clanginghowl.item.x_ray.2: §7Each second of use consumes energy. The gadget can be charged using a Portable Charger or a Stationary Charging Station
info.clanginghowl.item.barrier.2: §7Has a high energy consumption that scales with the amount of damage you take.
info.clanginghowl.item.barrier.3: §7The gadget can be charged using a Portable Charger or a Stationary Charging Station
info.clanginghowl.item.tendon.3: §6+15§6% §7additional movement speed and §6+50§6% §7jump height while sprinting.
info.clanginghowl.item.tendon.4: §7This gadget consume energy while sprinting. The gadget can be charged using a portable charger or a stationary charging station
info.clanginghowl.item.glove.2: §7When you perform a critical attack, it creates an §belectrical surge §7that deals area damage, slowing all those hit and charging all your other gadgets and advanced tools by 20 units of energy.
info.clanginghowl.item.glove.3: §7When the gadget is triggered, it goes into temporary recharge and loses part of its energy capacity. The gadget can be charged using a portable charger or a stationary charging station
info.clanginghowl.item.boots.3: §7You can perform a §6rocket jump §7while in the air. When performing a rocket jump, this gadget will go on a temporary recharge and consume fuel.
info.clanginghowl.item.boots.4: §7Fuel is automatically replenished when using a gadget with zero fuel and a Blaze Fuel Cylinder in your inventory. This consumes one fuel cylinder.
info.clanginghowl.item.battery.2: §7When you deal or receive damage, charge all other gadgets and advanced tools in your inventory equal to the amount of damage you dealt or received
info.clanginghowl.item.reanimator.1: §7Saves you from lethal damage by creating an electrical surge upon activation, after which it completely discharges and goes into a temporary recharge.
info.clanginghowl.item.reanimator.2: §7Reanimator will not be able to work again until it is fully charged and recharged. The gadget can be charged using a portable charger or a stationary charging station
info.clanginghowl.item.attraction_device: §7Right-clicking applies §9Attraction (0:25) §7on you and consumes the device's durability
info.clanginghowl.block.former.0: §8Forms a small cold zone around itself while active.
info.clanginghowl.block.former.1: §8In an active state, §7Extraterrestrial Energy Crystals §8begin to gradually grow on it. The colder the biome, the larger the crystals can grow.
info.clanginghowl.block.former.2: §8The crystal former can be turned on and off by applying a redstone signal or using an Industrial Adjustable Wrench.
info.clanginghowl.block.charger: §7Gradually charges the §eEnergy §7reserve of advanced tools placed on it.
info.clanginghowl.block.barrier: §7Protects a 128x128 block radius area from meteor showers
info.clanginghowl.block.broken_former: §7Creates an uncontrollable area of cold around itself
info.clanginghowl.block.flame_spewer.1: §8While active, it emits a stream of flame
info.clanginghowl.block.flame_spewer.2: §8The Flame Spewer can be turned on and off by applying a redstone signal or using an Industrial Adjustable Wrench
info.clanginghowl.block.sensor: §8Emits a redstone signal when an entity is within 15 blocks of its field of vision
info.clanginghowl.block.radar: §8Emits a redstone signal during a meteor shower
